body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Sambo Hitech(www.sbcctv.co.kr) expects to present its color super IR LED camera 'SZI 108' at the upcoming CES 2009 held in Las Vegas, which is equipped with a 2.5x zoom lens with auto focus and a 1/4-inch Sony color Exview CCD.
